_readme: Independent monthly cost benchmarks for a retiree household, used by
scripts/verify-affordability.ts to calibrate the model.
This is the ONLY check that can catch a constant that is sourced but wrong.
Plausibility bounds and coverage reports verify internal consistency; only
real observed costs verify that the model is pointed at reality.
Entries are UMass Boston 2025 Elder Index values for one adult age 65+,
good health, at county-level market costs. The Index includes housing,
health care, food, transportation, and miscellaneous essentials. It is an
independent model, not a sample of this app's inputs.
The release gate compares the `modest` spending profile to these figures.
`typical` (BLS 65+ mean) is expected to read high and is not the gate.
Component split: actualHousing is the Elder Index housing brick;
actualNonHousing is total minus housing (food + transportation +
miscellaneous + health). Modeled non-housing is everyday costs plus
Medicare/Medigap premiums.
Gate:
- non-housing error <= 20% on every entry (the spending-profile claim).
- total error <= 20% on every `rent` entry (ACS gross rent vs Elder
renter housing is like-for-like).
- own_outright and buying housing are reported, not gated: those
tenures price the city's typical ZHVI home plus 1% maintenance, which
is not the Elder Index modest dwelling. Rankings still work; the
dollar total for ownership in expensive metros will read high.
`id` must match locations_location.id. `tenure` is rent, own_outright, or buying.
